Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. Short answers up front: yes, we can structure a Marketplace private offer that starts as a 3‑month credited pilot and converts to a 12‑month PO on mutual signoff. Below is the proposed approach and the approval rotation we recommend to keep activation within your 9/10 target.

1) Pilot credit structure (seller side)
- Issue a private-offer coupon that applies up to $12,000 in usage credits for 90 days.
- Credits attach to the private offer; customer redeems via AWS Console during activation.
- If customer elects to convert to a 12-month PO, unused credits are forfeited or can be rolled into a (small) activation credit on the annual commit — to be defined in the conversion clause.

2) Pricing & conversion triggers
- Conversion pricing: propose a 15% discount off our standard marketplace list for the first 12 months post-conversion (volume tiers to be applied if usage exceeds X tokens/month).
- Trigger for conversion: TerraHealth technical approval + procurement confirmation + CFO PO signoff.

3) Approval rotation (to minimize stalls)
- Step A (Day 0–2): Tech review (IT) — we provide a short technical checklist and a sandbox link for validation.
- Step B (Day 2–5): Procurement checks the vendor paperwork (attachments received).
- Step C (Day 5–7): Finance (CFO) final signoff for PO or annual conversion.
- If any approver is delayed >48 hours, we’ll escalate to a named backup approver to keep to the 9/10 activation target.

4) Activation lead times (seller ops)
- Private-offer creation: 1 business day after paperwork confirmed.
- Activation in buyer console: typically instant once offer is accepted; marketplace gating (KYC/legal) can add 2–3 business days in rare cases.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben will send a short legal checklist and the draft conversion clause for your procurement/legal to review.
- Vivek can host a 30-minute CFO sync tomorrow or Wednesday to walk the conversion economics.

If that sounds good I’ll flag the HubSpot record and send a DocuSign for the initial pilot authorization.

Best,
Naomi
